additional_context: FHIR-39754 is a duplicate of FHIR-39753. Later Zulip discussion and FHIR-I review found the default-recursive interpretation unworkable for common Composition, Parameters, and related profiles. FHIR-57266 now records a Resolved - change required core decision to revise the wording, paired with FHIR-57265 in FHIR-extensions to define contentReferenceProfile; neither later issue is Applied/Published in this applied-published seed run, and the extension is not present in the checked extension-pack source.
